baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative ٱنطَلِقُوا۟ and the goal phrase إِلَىٰ مَا make the denied referent the endpoint of motion.
baseline_models.mechanism: Release from restraint is given a fixed direction: the addressees' sustained act of declaring something false becomes the relation along which they are transferred toward it. كُنتُم stretches that relation across prior time rather than presenting an isolated denial.

activation_trace.role: Letting loose from restraint supplies the command's release image, while إِلَىٰ turns that release into directed transfer.
Occurrence and temporal predication make denial an established prior condition carried into the present command.
Declaring a thing false identifies the sustained stance whose object is now made the destination.

changed_reading.before: Go to the punishment that you denied.
changed_reading.after: Be released into direct encounter with the very referent that your sustained declaring-false had kept at a verbal distance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired focus roots in ٱنطَلِقُوا۟ and تُكَذِّبُونَ both carry kinetic branch images.
baseline_models.mechanism: Unrestrained running is set beside the branch in which a charge proves true only by being carried through and proves false by stopping short. The command then bodily completes the encounter that denial had treated as a failed or unreal charge.

activation_trace.role: An unheld run supplies forward motion toward a specified end.
A charge that fails to carry through supplies an exploratory performance-image for denial rather than a direct gloss of the form.

changed_reading.before: The command merely relocates people who held a false belief.
changed_reading.after: The command forces a failed verbal charge to be carried through as an embodied encounter with its denied endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The previously indefinite object of denial becomes a promised threat that falls into actuality at a fixed appointment and separates truth from falsehood. Motion toward مَا is therefore motion into an arriving, adjudicating event-complex.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the referent false supplies the focus stance that the surrounding promise overturns.
A threatening promise supplies the hostile futurity gathered by the focus relative pronoun.
Falling and becoming fixed turns the threatened statement into an event that has arrived.
Fixing something to a time or limit gives the encounter an appointed boundary.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood makes the destination evidentiary as well as punitive.

structural_cues: 77:7 states that what is promised is واقع, and 77:11-14 fixes the messengers to the Day of Separation.
The three passive dismantling clauses in 77:8-10 intervene between promise and appointment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threat, occurrence, temporal fixing, and adjudicating separation; I infer that مَا in 77:29 gathers this scheduled complex into one destination. A live alternative is that مَا points more narrowly to the fire scene disclosed in 77:30-33.

changed_reading.before: They are sent toward an unspecified punishment they rejected.
changed_reading.after: They are sent into the promised event precisely as it becomes actual, reaches its appointment, and separates their denial from what proves true.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated third-person labeling as ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ accumulates around the second-person focus clause. The focus no longer reports only something they used to do; it addresses people whom repetition has constituted as deniers, then makes the object of that identity their destination.

activation_trace.role: The focus verb supplies the act of declaring the referent false.
The first refrain turns the same declaring-false branch into a recurring collective label.
The refrain immediately before 77:29 pivots directly from the label 'deniers' to second-person confrontation.
The refrain after the destination scene confirms that the enacted encounter remains keyed to the same identity.

structural_cues: The identical refrain occurs at 77:15, 19, 24, 28, 34, 37, 40, 45, 47, and 49.
77:28 is immediately adjacent to the focus command, while 77:34 closes its first destination description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ten repetitions of the collective label around one second-person denial clause; I infer that iteration converts an act into a durable social identity. A live alternative is that the refrain remains rhetorical punctuation and does not change the clause's referential scope.

changed_reading.before: The verse confronts people about a past act of denial.
changed_reading.after: The verse converts the surah's repeatedly named 'deniers' from an observed class into directly addressed travelers whose identity now determines their destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding creation sequence repeatedly holds, places, measures, gathers, and anchors. Against that material system, the focus release-command is a reversal: those once carried in secure and fixed arrangements are discharged from containment toward what they denied.

activation_trace.role: Release from restraint supplies the reversal from prior holding to terminal discharge.
Fixity and settledness supply the stable holding condition that release interrupts.
A place of being sharpens the repository as a bounded location rather than abstract security.
A measure reaching its limit supplies the terminal point at which containment can end.
Gathering and gripping into a receptacle makes the earth an active container for living and dead.
Firm anchoring extends the preceding scene's material vocabulary of stabilization.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 moves from lowly fluid into a secure repository until a known measure.
77:25-27 presents earth as gathering living and dead, then adds fixed mountains and fresh water before 77:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repository, place, measured limit, receptacle, and anchoring; I infer that the release verb at 77:29 reverses this chain of containment once its measure is complete. A live alternative is that 77:29 simply starts a new punishment scene without materially reversing the creation sequence.

changed_reading.after: At the end of a measured life of being held and stabilized, be discharged from the world's containers into the reality you denied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated imperative carries the focus command directly into a branching shadow that lacks shade's protective function and cannot suffice against flame. The denied object is thus staged as an anti-shelter: it has the appearance and name of cover while failing the reality of cover.

activation_trace.role: Unrestrained going supplies the motion whose destination the next command specifies.
Declaring something false supplies the epistemic mismatch that the failed shelter makes material.
Exact renewed unrestrained-going language binds the destination description to the focus command.
Shade as covering supplies the apparent function offered by the destination.
Branching and divergence give the apparent cover a spreading form without making it protective.
Protective shelter is explicitly negated, exposing the shadow as non-protection.
Sufficiency supplies the function that the shadow fails to perform.
The tongue and ignition of fire supplies the force from which the apparent cover gives no relief.

structural_cues: 77:30 repeats ٱنطَلِقُوا۟ exactly and replaces the focus's relative destination with إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ.
77:31 negates both shade-giving and protection from flame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact imperative repetition, branching shadow, negated shelter, failed sufficiency, and flame; I infer that 77:30-31 concretizes the focus's denied object as a functionally false cover. A live alternative is that the shadow is only one part of a broader denied judgment rather than the exhaustive referent of مَا.

changed_reading.before: Go to a generic punishment you denied.
changed_reading.after: Enter the denied reality as a counterfeit shelter whose branching appearance cannot perform shelter, making denial's mismatch between label and truth physically inhabitable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus begins with a prior speech-act of declaring false and a present command to move. The later scene removes speaking, permission, and excuse while gathering everyone for separating judgment. Movement toward the denied object therefore reads as transfer from contestable discourse into a forum where the referent no longer admits verbal revision.

activation_trace.role: Declaring false supplies the prior speech-act whose efficacy is withdrawn.
Going without restraint supplies bodily movement after verbal agency ceases to govern the encounter.
Speech itself is the capacity explicitly absent in the destination scene.
Permission supplies the procedural opening that is denied to them.
Excuse and exculpation supply the unavailable means of revising their prior stance.
Adjudication separating truth from falsehood gives the silent encounter its forensic function.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the collective forum into which the command transfers them.

structural_cues: 77:35-36 pairs 'they do not speak' with 'they are not permitted, so that they might excuse themselves.'
77:38 names the Day of Separation and gathers the addressees with the earlier peoples.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior declaring-false, later silence, withheld permission, unavailable excuse, adjudication, and gathering; I infer a transfer from disputable claim to non-negotiable evidence. A live alternative is that the silence is a separate punishment and does not specifically transform the motion-command in 77:29.

changed_reading.before: The command is chiefly physical relocation.
changed_reading.after: The command transfers former speakers into an assembled evidentiary scene where the reality they denied can no longer be talked away or excused.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later parallel بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ treats sustained past conduct as the ground of present outcome, and recompense explicitly matches deed to return. The focus's كُنتُم ... تُكَذِّبُونَ is thereby activated as a conduct record whose destination is its own measured consequence, not merely a mistaken opinion being corrected.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication holds denial across a past span as a durable record.
Declaring false supplies the conduct whose consequence is encountered.
The repeated past-predication frame creates a grammatical bridge between denial and action.
Intentional action supplies the category into which the parallel construction draws sustained denial.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the causal link from past record to present destination.
Enjoyed benefit supplies the temporary alternative orientation that precedes terminal encounter.
Smallness and brevity limit that enjoyment and prevent it from functioning as escape.

structural_cues: 77:29's مَا كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ is answered by the parallel بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ in 77:43.
The paired imperatives of 77:43 and 77:46 distribute present eating and enjoyment according to prior conduct and sharply limit the latter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel temporal-action clauses, recompense, and limited enjoyment; I infer that denial functions as accumulated conduct generating a matching destination. A live alternative is that the parallel only contrasts groups and does not classify denial itself as work.

changed_reading.before: They encounter evidence correcting a wrong belief.
changed_reading.after: They encounter the recompensed outcome of a sustained practice: denial has become a deed-record that directs where they now go.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing question places renewed report, temporal after-ness, and heart-settling assent beyond the discourse just heard. This makes the focus encounter double: they approach both the event they denied and the final verification of a report after which no later discourse remains to secure belief.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the referent false supplies the failed response to the report.
Speech renewed as report supplies the possible later vehicle of persuasion that the question closes off.
After-ness relative to what came before marks the exhausted temporal space for another report.
Assent in which the heart settles supplies the response that no subsequent report is expected to produce.

structural_cues: 77:50 closes the whole surah with a rhetorical question about what report after it could produce belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies renewed report, after-ness, and settled assent; I infer that the denied مَا is simultaneously announced discourse and the event that verifies it. A live alternative is that حَدِيث refers to the surah's discourse generally without narrowing onto 77:29's relative pronoun.

changed_reading.before: The denied object is only an external future event.
changed_reading.after: The destination is the event as verification of the final report they rejected, after which no fresh report remains as an epistemic exit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because labor pain is a form-distant branch image for the imperative, not its direct sense. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the packet's fluid-in-the-womb, repository, and measured-limit images immediately before the command. Downstream prose should present it only as a lexical-material echo of forced emergence, never as a translation of ٱنطَلِقُوا۟.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root ط ل ق in ٱنطَلِقُوا۟ has a labor-pain branch capable of recasting release as emergence from containment.

activation_trace.role: Labor pains supply a branch-distant image of compelled emergence rather than ordinary travel.
Male fluid in the womb supplies the generative material setting for the emergence image.
Fixity and settlement supply the protected holding phase before emergence.
A measure reaching its boundary supplies the moment at which holding gives way to release.

changed_reading.before: Proceed from one location to another.
changed_reading.after: Emerge under terminal pressure from a measured enclosure into the denied reality, like a punitive second birth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the same focus root inventory contains both release and a leather fetter, while the later gathering root contains a hand-to-neck fetter branch; neither distant branch is the direct contextual gloss. The opposition remains anchored in ٱنطَلِقُوا۟ and gains a carceral mechanism from 77:38. Downstream prose should qualify it as an antipodal root-image suggesting transfer into tighter custody, not claim that the command lexically means 'be bound.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root ط ل ق in the imperative holds an internal release/fetter opposition.

activation_trace.role: Release from restraint supplies the surface vector of departure.
A leather fetter supplies the root's antipodal counterimage and makes the apparent release unstable.
A fetter gathering hands to neck supplies the exploratory custodial endpoint of the release.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are simply released to move.
changed_reading.after: Their apparent release is a custodial transfer: they are let loose from one restraint only to be gathered into the restraint of judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet never explicitly says whether the addressees can resist the command in 77:29. It remains anchored in the focus imperative and in the later command/refusal construction at 77:48, which supplies a clear contrast between rejected humbling and directed motion. Downstream prose should render an asymmetry of commands, not assert as narrated fact that physical compulsion occurs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative ٱنطَلِقُوا۟ can be compared with the later imperative ٱرْكَعُوا۟ and its explicit refusal.

activation_trace.role: Unrestrained going supplies the motion-command whose practical force is being tested.
Spoken command supplies the explicit instruction frame shared structurally with the focus imperative.
Humbling and submission supply the voluntary posture that the addressees refuse.

changed_reading.before: Both imperatives are merely commands addressed to deniers.
changed_reading.after: The surah contrasts a humbling command they refuse with a destination-command they must confront, sharpening 77:29 as the consequence of rejected voluntary submission.

strongest_changes: The promised threat, its occurrence, fixed appointment, and separating judgment turn the indefinite مَا into an arriving event-complex.
The creation sequence's repositories, measures, receptacles, and anchors make ٱنطَلِقُوا۟ a reversal from being held to being terminally discharged.
The exact renewed imperative in 77:30 materializes the denied object as a branching but functionally false shelter.
Later silence and recompense recast denial as both an exhausted speech-act and accumulated conduct with a matching destination.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet activated long-range inversions without forcing them into one reading: containment versus release, claim versus non-negotiable encounter, apparent shade versus failed protection, and temporary conduct versus measured return. It also kept form-distant labor and fetter branches as contained exploratory images.
remaining_uncertainties: The scope of مَا may be the immediate shadow-and-flame scene, the whole Day of Separation, or both at different levels.
Release from restraint may be a live irony in the imperative or only background root imagery behind ordinary directed movement.
The labor-pain and fetter activations are mechanistically productive but too branch-distant to use as direct lexical renderings.
The command asymmetry with 77:48 suggests compelled encounter but does not itself narrate the addressees' response to 77:29.
